originalTitle: Calcutta Stock Exchange seeks to put exit application on hold
simplifiedContent: The Calcutta Stock Exchange, a place where people buy and sell stocks, had previously asked to stop operating, but now it wants to reverse that decision. This change of heart is because the government of West Bengal is supporting the exchange and wants it to stay open. The exchange will soon officially ask to take back its request to stop operating. The state government has shared its plan to help the exchange with the central government, but the exchange still faces some big hurdles to overcome. This matters because it could mean that the Calcutta Stock Exchange will continue to operate, giving people another option for buying and selling stocks.

originalTitle: Global Market: CXMT set for July 27 Shanghai debut in Asia's biggest IPO of 2026
simplifiedContent: A big company called CXMT, which makes memory chips, is going to start selling its shares on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on July 27. This is a significant event because CXMT is raising a lot of money, 29.5 billion yuan, which is expected to be the largest initial public offering (IPO) in Asia this year. An IPO is when a company issues shares to the public for the first time, allowing people to buy a part of the company. This debut matters because it shows that CXMT is growing and expanding, and it may be an opportunity for investors to buy into a leading technology company. The large size of the IPO also suggests that CXMT has a strong plan for its future and is attracting a lot of interest from investors.

originalTitle: Rekha Jhunjhunwala sells 1 crore Canara Bank shares in Q1. What's behind the move?
simplifiedContent: Rekha Jhunjhunwala, a well-known investor, sold over 1.07 crore shares of Canara Bank between April and June. This means she now owns a smaller part of the bank, decreasing her share from 1.54% to 1.42%. She made this sale at a time when Canara Bank's stock price had fallen by 18% in 2026. This sale is noteworthy because it shows a change in Jhunjhunwala's investment plans for the bank. The reason behind her decision to sell is not specified, but it happened during a period when the bank's stock was not performing well.

originalTitle: Landmark Cars shares jump 17.5% to six-month high after record June-quarter sales
simplifiedContent: The stock price of Landmark Cars increased by 17.5% to ₹496.70, which is the highest it has been in six months. This happened after the company reported its best sales ever for the quarter, making ₹1,733 crore, which is 22.47% more than the same time last year. This is significant because it shows that the company is doing well and making more money than before. The company thinks it will keep selling more because it will be releasing new models soon. This increase in stock price is important because it reflects the company's strong performance and potential for future growth.

originalTitle: Defence stocks to buy or sell: Kotak expects defence upcycle to continue, prefers HAL over peers
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening: India is expected to spend more money on defense, with an 11% increase each year until 2030. This is because the country plans to buy more defense equipment from local companies. A company called Kotak thinks this will be good for defense companies, especially one called HAL. Kotak is cautiously choosing which defense companies to invest in, but thinks HAL is a better choice than others. This matters because it could be a good time to invest in defense companies like HAL, but it's still important to be careful and choose wisely.

originalTitle: Higher oil prices to rising bond yields: 5 key risks that could keep the Indian stock market under pressure in 2026
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market might be unstable in 2026 due to several risks. Some of the main concerns are higher oil prices, increasing bond yields, and rising inflation, which can all affect the market's performance. This means that the value of stocks might go up and down quickly, making it a volatile time for investors. As a result, investors should be prepared for potential losses and uncertainty in the short term. Overall, these challenges could put pressure on the Indian stock market and make it harder for it to recover.
